iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a NEW production seated idle animation for the existing white pixel-art desktop kitten Neko. This is NOT a breathing animation. The user rejected a breathing/chest-shading pulse and a static-body eye-only loop. They want natural connected cat body movement while the animal stays planted in the same place.
Reference1 exact canonical kitten identity. Reference2 previous expressive sheet for familiar face/palette only, NOT its bobbing/tilting poses.
ONE transparent RGBA sheet, EXACTLY4 columns by2 rows,8 chronological complete kitten drawings, same camera/physical scale and generous margins. White fur, charcoal stepped outlines, gray chin/chest, pink ears/nose, dark eyes and square highlights. Crisp clean pixel clusters. No labels, text, grid, shadow, floor, hearts, haze, props or loose fragments.
Mechanics informed by compact sitting-cat idle examples: one small seated weight-settle, not a walk, not breathing, not rhythmic up/down bouncing. Both front paws and the haunches remain planted at IDENTICAL coordinates and ground baseline in every drawing. The tail stays attached and mostly quiet on viewer right. The pelvis stays centered over the same seated footprint. Neck/chest/forelegs articulate coherently: one shoulder eases toward its supporting foreleg by only1–2 final desktop pixels, the elbow softens, then the shoulder returns. The other foreleg supports and stays straight. Do not translate, scale, shrink or stretch the whole animal. Do not move paw positions, lift the body, or slide the haunches. Head crown/eye line stay at the same HEIGHT throughout; the head can follow the tiny shoulder settle sideways by at most1 final pixel. No head tilt here (that already has a separate gesture).
Source sequence row-major:
0 exact neutral canonical sit, awake eyes, relaxed ears, tiny quiet mouth.
1 a small alert ear pivot (one ear, not both flapping), eyes attend calmly; body still supported.
2 beginning of the small weight-settle: viewer-left shoulder eases sideways1 pixel, its foreleg bends slightly at elbow while its paw stays EXACTLY planted; hips/pelvis unchanged. Neck follows shoulder, not a floating head. Mouth quiet, ears soft.
3 settled weight on that same foreleg: shoulder shift no more than2 desktop pixels, opposite shoulder/foreleg counter-support; head same height and size, eyelids gently soften. NO chest inflating or shading pulse.
4 warm half-lids as shoulders start returning toward center; tiny content smile, ears relaxed.
5 quick happy closed-eye arcs, body returning through a connected intermediate support pose. NO long sleepy closure.
6 eyes reopening through partial lids, shoulders and forelegs almost neutral again; head height fixed.
7 complete drawn neutral recovery matching0, both eyes open, level head, all paws and haunch in their starting places.
Playback draft: neutral holds2100ms, ear response200ms, settle entry200ms, supported settle350ms, half-close100ms, closed100ms, reopen100ms, recovery250ms, then quiet neutral2400ms. Brisk blink300ms; a natural one-off settle separated by real stillness. Don't animate every body part at the same time. Make the body motion readable through true connected contour/limb drawing, not patchy changing chest texture. Keep the seated head width62px/body height82px physical ratio from the reference. Avoid per-frame line wobble or redraw noise in the face and paws. Every extreme and in-between must preserve identity, volume and planted support. We will use one constant calibration and exact support registration, reject any size drift, and review at native desktop scale. This whole sequence must be authored as coherent full-body poses; do not present a static body with only blinking eyes.
